_readme: Claude Desktop only supports stdio MCP servers (local subprocesses).
It cannot connect directly to a remote HTTP URL.
Use videoweave-mcp-bridge to proxy between Claude Desktop and the VideoWeave server.
3. Copy videoweave-mcp-bridge to somewhere on your PATH, e.g.:
Windows:      copy videoweave-mcp-bridge.py to a folder in PATH
Replace vw_YOUR_API_KEY_HERE with your key from Settings → API Keys in VideoWeave.
